findings: Risk statement identifies potential for digest or reference replacement and canonical source impersonation.
Required control mandates binding of algorithm, version, source and subject with tamper rejection and no silent repair.
Stop condition SOURCE_OR_INTEGRITY_BINDING_MISSING is active, indicating the binding is not yet established or verified.
Status remains OPEN with formal reviewer required.
required_corrections: Implement and document explicit binding of algorithm, version, source and subject for all digests and references.
Enforce tamper detection that rejects on mismatch without silent repair or fallback substitution.
Provide evidence that SOURCE_OR_INTEGRITY_BINDING_MISSING stop condition is resolved before execution proceeds.
residual_risks: Residual risk of impersonation if binding metadata is incomplete or not enforced at every verification point.
Residual risk of silent failure if stop condition enforcement is bypassed in downstream tooling.

findings: Risk statement identifies potential for replayed or duplicate packages to be presented as new successful executions.
Required control mandates unique package identity, time policy, deduplication and immutable replay status.
Stop condition REPLAY_OR_DUPLICATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN is active, indicating replay and deduplication status is not yet determined.
Status remains OPEN with formal reviewer required.
required_corrections: Assign and enforce unique package identity with non-reusable identifiers.
Define and enforce time policy for package acceptance and expiration.
Implement deduplication logic with immutable replay status that cannot be reset or overwritten.
Provide evidence that REPLAY_OR_DUPLICATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN stop condition is resolved.
residual_risks: Residual risk of replay acceptance if identity or time policy is not consistently enforced across all ingestion paths.
Residual risk of status mutation if replay status storage is not immutable.

findings: Risk statement identifies potential for cross-tenant or cross-entity binding to disclose data or misattribute identity.
Required control mandates tenant and subject binding, authorization checks and correlation conflict rejection.
Stop condition TENANT_OR_SUBJECT_BINDING_CONFLICTED is active, indicating binding conflicts are not yet resolved.
Status remains OPEN with formal reviewer required.
required_corrections: Enforce strict tenant and subject binding at every access and correlation point.
Implement authorization checks that reject cross-tenant or cross-entity access by default.
Detect and reject correlation conflicts with explicit stop condition enforcement.
Provide evidence that TENANT_OR_SUBJECT_BINDING_CONFLICTED stop condition is resolved.
residual_risks: Residual risk of data disclosure if tenant isolation is not enforced at all data boundaries.
Residual risk of identity misattribution if subject binding is incomplete or inconsistent.

findings: Risk statement identifies potential for compromised or expired issuer or verifier identity to remain trusted.
Required control mandates binding of issuer status, validity interval, revocation reference and incident response path.
Stop condition ISSUER_OR_VERIFIER_STATUS_NOT_CURRENT is active, indicating issuer or verifier status is not verified as current.
Status remains OPEN with formal reviewer required.
required_corrections: Bind and verify issuer status and validity interval at every trust decision point.
Implement revocation reference checks with current revocation data.
Define and document incident response path for compromised or expired identities.
Provide evidence that ISSUER_OR_VERIFIER_STATUS_NOT_CURRENT stop condition is resolved.
residual_risks: Residual risk of trusting expired or revoked identities if revocation data is stale or unavailable.
Residual risk of delayed incident response if response path is not tested or enforced.

findings: Risk statement identifies potential for raw payloads, credentials, secrets or sensitive content to enter a portable package.
Required control mandates deny-by-default content policy with allowlists, redaction, secret scans and stop conditions.
Stop condition SENSITIVE_CONTENT_POLICY_UNRESOLVED is active, indicating sensitive content policy is not yet enforced.
Status remains OPEN with formal reviewer required.
required_corrections: Implement deny-by-default content policy for all portable packages.
Define and enforce allowlists for permitted content types and fields.
Apply redaction and secret scanning before package creation or transmission.
Enforce SENSITIVE_CONTENT_POLICY_UNRESOLVED stop condition to block packages that fail content policy.
Provide evidence that SENSITIVE_CONTENT_POLICY_UNRESOLVED stop condition is resolved.
residual_risks: Residual risk of sensitive content leakage if allowlists are overly permissive or not updated.
Residual risk of undetected secrets if scanning tools are not comprehensive or are bypassed.

blockers: All five security risks have active stop conditions that must be resolved before acceptance.
No evidence provided that any required controls are implemented or verified.
Formal reviewer sign-off is required for all items and has not been obtained.
required_corrections: Resolve SOURCE_OR_INTEGRITY_BINDING_MISSING for VEAP-SEC-001.
Resolve REPLAY_OR_DUPLICATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN for VEAP-SEC-002.
Resolve TENANT_OR_SUBJECT_BINDING_CONFLICTED for VEAP-SEC-003.
Resolve ISSUER_OR_VERIFIER_STATUS_NOT_CURRENT for VEAP-SEC-004.
Resolve SENSITIVE_CONTENT_POLICY_UNRESOLVED for VEAP-SEC-005.
Provide documented evidence of control implementation and verification for each risk.
Obtain formal reviewer sign-off for all items.
